extName.description: Extension name shown in the browser and the store.

extDescription.message: Per-tab volume with boost and mono audio. Light, open source, and it fully lets go of the tab when you're done.

limiterHint.message: Keeps boosted sound from distorting. While it's lit, turning up further compresses the sound instead of making it louder.

statusIdle.description: The extension is not doing anything to this tab.

statusActive.description: The extension is processing this tab's audio.

monoHint.message: Mono audio: play both channels in both ears (fixes one-sided sound)

releaseHint.message: Stop controlling this tab and leave it exactly as it was

noticeRestricted.message: The browser doesn't allow controlling audio on this page.

noticeFailed.message: Couldn't take control of this tab. Reload the page and try again.
